standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: Ah! Is it gone yet? Did you kill it?

standard-dialogue.player: Kill what? Are you okay? What's wrong?

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: I... I'm not the bravest amongst my friends and when I left the group I saw this huge, creepy, green-skinned creature! I thought it was going to eat me!

standard-dialogue.player: Oh! You mean a goblin! I suppose they would be quite a bit scarier from your perspective.

standard-dialogue.speaker: Monkey
standard-dialogue.text: I... don't know what it is but please just send me back to Ape Atoll. I don't think I am cut out for this.

standard-dialogue.player: It's okay, you're safe now inside this cage and you'll be back home before you know it.

using-donie-s-caged-monkey-on-an-affecte.text: There is already a monkey in that cage!
